title: Read-only Git provider
objective: Complete the read-only Git portion of COTRA-P02 with typed status, diff, and log operations that cannot widen into general shell or network authority.

include: MCP tools for typed read-only Git

authority_delta.filesystem: Read-only Git metadata/content through fixed Git subcommands inside trusted workspaces
authority_delta.process: Internal fixed git executable invocation only; no client-selected executable or argv surface
authority_delta.secrets: Git child receives a curated environment without Cotra/tunnel secret variables

invariants: No generic git command or shell tool is exposed
Reported repository root must resolve inside the trusted workspace
External diff and textconv are disabled
Git output is bounded and commands time out
No network Git subcommand is exposed

acceptance.claim: git.status reports working tree state without mutation.
git.diff returns bounded worktree or staged diff with external diff/textconv disabled.
Non-repositories and out-of-workspace repository roots fail closed.
No client-controlled executable, raw argv, shell, or network operation is introduced.
Windows and portable exact-head CI pass.

done_when: Exact-head Windows/Ubuntu CI and semantic review pass, the PR is merged, and post-merge CI is green.
